title: CoreByte
description: CoreByte is a 100% free-to-play Minecraft Survival server built around fairness, progression, and community.
body:
⚡ CoreByte — Fair Survival. No Pay-to-Win. Community-Driven.

Welcome to CoreByte, a Minecraft network built around one core idea:



Minecraft should reward effort, creativity, and time — not money.



Too many servers lock gameplay advantages behind paywalls.

CoreByte was created to be the opposite of that.



Here, progress is earned through gameplay, not bought.



Whether you enjoy building massive bases, automating machines, exploring the world, or simply relaxing with other players, CoreByte aims to become a long-term Minecraft home rather than another temporary server.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



⭐ CoreByte Highlights

• 100% No Pay-to-Win
• Survival + Creative servers
• Jobs Economy system
• Slimefun technology & automation
• Land Claim Protection
• Java + Bedrock Crossplay
• Fair progression systems
• Friendly growing community



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



🧭 What Makes CoreByte Different



💰 Fair Gameplay First



CoreByte is designed so that all meaningful progression is earned in-game.



There are no paid ranks that give gameplay advantages.

Supporter ranks are purely cosmetic and help support server development.



Everyone progresses through time, effort, and creativity.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



⚙ Survival Features

Our survival server blends classic Minecraft with progression systems that keep the gameplay fresh.



💰 Player Economy
Earn money through jobs and trading with other players.



⚙ Slimefun Technology
Unlock machines, automation systems, and advanced tools.



🏡 Land Claiming
Protect your builds and expand your territory safely.



⚰ Graves System
Recover your items after death.



🛒 CoreByte Marketplace
Spend in-game currency on quality-of-life upgrades.



🌍 Pre-Generated World
Smooth exploration without lag spikes.



⚡ Optimised Performance
Stable server performance even during heavy gameplay.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



🌐 Network Servers



🏛 Lobby
The central hub connecting the CoreByte network.



🌲 Survival
Economy, jobs, Slimefun progression, land protection, and community gameplay.



🎨 Creative
Claim plots and build freely with unlimited creativity.

Additional features and improvements are regularly added based on community feedback.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



🔧 Actively Developed

CoreByte is actively maintained and updated.



New features, improvements, and systems are constantly being developed based on player feedback and community suggestions.



This is a server designed to grow long-term with its community.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



🌱 Early Players Matter

CoreByte is still growing, which means players joining now have a unique opportunity to:



• Become part of the first generation of players
• Help shape the server's future
• Build early economy influence
• Be recognised as OG community members



Joining early means you get to grow with the server from the beginning.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



🔌 Server Information



Java Edition IP:
play.corebyte.org



Bedrock Edition IP
play.corebyte.org:25573



Supported Versions
1.13 → 1.21.11



CoreByte supports Java and Bedrock crossplay, allowing players from both editions to play together.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



💬 Join the Community
https://discord.gg/beFD4ZeeVF

Our Discord is where the community hangs out, shares builds, and suggests future features.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



⚡ CoreByte

Earn your progress.
Build your legacy.
